title: Maximum Consecutive Ones
problemStatement: Given a binary array `nums`, write a function `maxConsecutiveOnes(nums)` that returns the maximum number of consecutive 1s in the array.
description: The array contains only 0s and 1s. Consecutive means uninterrupted by a 0.
constraints:
1 <= nums.length <= 10^5
nums[i] is either 0 or 1
Time: O(N)
Space: O(1)
outputFormat: A single integer — the maximum streak of consecutive 1s.

examples.explanation: The longest streak of consecutive 1s is at the end: [1, 1, 1].
There are no 1s in the array.

explanation: Scan the array keeping a running count. Reset the count whenever a 0 is seen and track the maximum count at each step.

title: Find the Missing Number
problemStatement: Given an array `arr` containing `n - 1` distinct integers from the range 1 to n, write a function `findMissingNumber(arr, n)` that returns the one number from 1 to n which is missing from the array.
description: Exactly one number from 1 to n is missing. All other numbers appear exactly once.
constraints:
2 <= n <= 10^5
arr.length == n - 1
1 <= arr[i] <= n
Time: O(N)
Space: O(1)
inputFormat: An array of integers and the integer n.
outputFormat: A single integer — the missing number.

examples.explanation: The numbers 1 to 6 should be present; 3 is missing.
Only 1 is present, so 2 is missing.

explanation: Use the formula sum of 1..n = n * (n + 1) / 2. Subtract the sum of the array from it to get the missing number.

title: Longest Subarray with Sum K
problemStatement: Given an array `arr` and a target sum `k`, write a function `longestSubarray(arr, k)` that returns the length of the longest contiguous subarray whose elements sum exactly to `k`. If no such subarray exists, return 0.
description: The subarray must be contiguous. Elements can be positive or negative.
inputFormat: An array of integers and an integer k.
outputFormat: A single integer — the length of the longest subarray, or 0.

examples.explanation: The subarray [5, 2, 7, 1] sums to 15 and has length 4.

explanation: Maintain a prefix-sum map from prefix sum to its earliest index. Whenever (current sum - k) exists in the map, a valid subarray ends at the current index; keep track of the maximum length.
